esm.readme:
## RBAC (Permission-based)

A role maps to a list of permissions in `config/permissions.js`, and routes declare which permission they need:

```js
router.get("/admin-check", requireAuth, requirePermission("admin:access"), handler);
```

Add a new role, or change what an existing role can do, by editing `config/permissions.js` only. See `routes/admin.routes.js` for a working example (`GET /api/v1/admin-check`).
